text: LVII. 1. Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirass'; eva āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya. Katamehi sattahi? 2. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, bahussuto hoti, paṭisallīno hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, satimā hoti, paññavā hoti. Imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirass'; eva āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā ti.
